login.title: Sign in to Stroppy Cloud
login.devBody: This stand runs without Kratos: enter one of the static tokens configured on the server (STROPPY_DEV_USERS).
login.subtitle: Sign in to launch runs and see the results.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Display name
register.closedBody: This installation does not accept self sign-up. Ask the platform administrator for an account.
register.nameRequired: Enter your name: your teammates will see you under it
register.subtitle: The account is free; the machines for your runs live in your own cloud.
register.nextStep: Next we'll email you a code to confirm your address.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.intro: We'll email you a 6-digit code. Until the address is confirmed, tenant invitations can't reach you.
verify.sentTo: The code was sent to {{email}}. Enter it below or open the link in the mail.
verify.codeFormat: The 6 digits from the email, e.g. 510938
verify.resent: A new code was sent to {{email}}
verify.banner: {{email}} isn't confirmed yet. Invitations and admin rights won't work until you confirm it.

recovery.title: Reset password
recovery.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send a code to sign in and change your password.
recovery.sentTo: If an account with {{email}} exists, the code is in the mail. Enter it below.

error.title: Sign-in error
error.notFound: This error has expired or wasn't found. Start signing in again.

kratos.4000040: That's not an email address. Example: name@company.com
kratos.4000031: The password is too similar to the e-mail. Pick another
kratos.4000032: The password is too short: at least {{min_length}} characters
kratos.4000033: The password is too long: at most {{max_length}} characters
kratos.4000034: This password appears in data breaches. Pick another
kratos.4000039: The new password must differ from the old one
kratos.4000007: An account with this e-mail exists. Sign in or reset the password
kratos.4000010: The account is not active: confirm your e-mail first
kratos.4010011: The account is disabled. Contact the platform admin
kratos.4050001: The change timed out. Try again
kratos.4060002: Reset failed. Request a new code
kratos.4060004: The reset link is invalid or already used
kratos.4060005: Reset timed out. Request a new code
kratos.4060006: The code is wrong or already used. Check the mail or request a new one
kratos.4070001: The confirmation link is invalid or already used
kratos.4070003: Confirmation failed. Request a new code
kratos.4070005: Confirmation timed out. Request a new code
kratos.4070006: The code is wrong or already used. Check the mail or request a new one

kratosError.network: The sign-in service is unreachable. Check the connection and retry
kratosError.self_service_flow_expired: This action timed out. Start over
kratosError.security_csrf_violation: The form expired. Reload the page and retry
kratosError.session_inactive: The session ended. Sign in again
kratosError.self_service_flow_return_to_forbidden: The return address is not allowed
kratosError.self_service_flow_disabled: This action is turned off on the platform

stand.title: A stand in your cloud
stand.body: The machines, the database and the load come up in your Yandex Cloud and are removed after the run.

checked.title: A checked result
checked.body: The stand passes its checks before the load, and afterwards you get a metrics report to compare with others.

rating.title: A place in the rating
rating.body: Publish runs to the public rating. Only runs of the same load scenario are compared, and every row shows its hardware.
